posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
The "one very long battle" theory doesn't work well with the environment mechanic, as those fights wouldn't all be in the same place.  There are probably lots of small conflicts, but I think the card games represent particularly strong interests, where the Chairman isn't just willing to let them slide when they're about to be lost, and steps in directly to try to save them.  That also explains why the Operative is there right off the bat.

I wish we'd had an Iron Legacy timeline variant of the "Chairman."  Could have been set up as the hurdles the rest of the Freedom Six have to go through to recruit Maia back to their side, or an even darker future where she goes back to run it after Iron Legacy is defeated.
